name: Field report
description: A short report with a clear title, sections and real paragraphs.

values.content: {"type": "doc", "content": [{"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 1}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Field report, third quarter"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Three teams moved to one design system this quarter. This report sets out what changed, what it cost and what comes next, in that order."}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 2}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "What changed"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Every campaign now starts from the same templates. Colour, type and logo choices are made once, so review time goes to the message instead of the margins."}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Regional teams translate and resize their own work. The central team reviews less and answers fewer tickets, which leaves room for the projects it was hired to do."}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 2}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "What it cost"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Two weeks of setup, one workshop per region and a change of habit. The first campaign took longer than the old way. The third took half the time."}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 2}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "What comes next"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Print is next. The stationery, signage and event kits move across in the new year, starting with the spring conference."}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 2}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "What we learned"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "The templates that got used were the ones people could finish in one sitting. Long, flexible layouts sat untouched. Short, opinionated ones spread by themselves."}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Reviews went faster when the rules were visible at the point of making rather than in a guideline nobody opened. Most questions now get answered before they are asked."}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 2}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Who to thank"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "The regional leads gave up two afternoons to test every template against real briefs. Their notes shaped the second round, and most of the wording in this report is theirs."}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Thanks also to the print team, who proved early that the same files could travel from screen to signage without being rebuilt."}]}]}
